entries.title: Each choice on a card sits beside what it is about
entries.body: When a card asks you about several findings or proposals, each question now sits inside the section it is about, instead of in one list at the end. Filing a task always puts it in your backlog, where it waits for Start, and your first mate says so when it files one.
entries.noPicture: This changes how the first mate and crew write cards and words, not a view of the app.
